ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my setup, but I would pass on this older model with a newer Echo Dot also offered.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on home viewing and security equipment, with no current need for wired earbuds.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to connect my video equipment to my 4K TV, and the extra length could help with placement.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so this offers little additional use.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no clear tablet need right now, and this older model does not directly improve my viewing or security setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage could be useful, but I would check my camera's card requirements before choosing this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K stick already covers streaming, so I would skip another HD device.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for hands-free Alexa access alongside my Fire TV devices.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk Ultra 64GB MicroSDXC Class 10 UHS Memory Card Speed Up To 30MB/s With Adapter - SDSDQUA-064G-U46A [Old Version]; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would verify compatibility and recording-speed requirements for my camera before buying this older card.
ItemID: NA; Title: OontZ Angle 3 Bluetooth Speaker, Portable Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Speaker, 10 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, IPX5 Water Resistant, Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need portable audio; my recent purchases center on home video and security.
